name: Deno
description: Deno runs TypeScript directly on V8 (type-stripped, not type-checked at run time): the same JIT-compiled engine as Node.js and Chrome, with a different runtime and standard library.

variants.name: deno run
variants.description: Default V8 flags; all permissions granted.

variants.name: deno run --v8-flags=--max-semi-space-size=64
variants.description: Larger young generation, fewer scavenges for allocation-heavy code.
